items.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.

items.title: Vertiv Sinks 9%, GE Vernova Down 8% as Democrats Win Congress, Reviving Data Center Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 9% today after Democrats won Congress, dragging GE Vernova, Eaton and CoreWeave down too. Developers will still need Vertiv’s gear even if they pay more for power, so the selloff looks overdone.

items.title: AMETEK, Eaton and Dover Are Delivering Record Results. Can Their Dividends Keep Growing?
items.summary: Order books at three industrial giants just hit records, and their dividends have grown every single year for over a decade. The real question is whether the debt piling up behind those records puts future raises at risk.

items.title: Eaton: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Boyd Thermal extends Eaton's reach from power distribution into chip cooling, a move that is already outperforming expectations.

items.title: Eaton Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Stronger 2027 Growth Outlook
items.summary: Eaton CEO Paulo Ruiz raises 2026 growth guidance and projects stronger 2027 demand, with Boyd Thermal's expanding revenues and electrical backlog fueling optimism.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% on Record Orders and Bernstein’s Data Center Call
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares rose 6% on Nov. 3 after Eaton’s record third-quarter orders and a bullish Bernstein note on data centers.
